# bitbucket_project_default_reviewer (Resource)

Adds a user as a default reviewer on every repository in a Bitbucket Cloud project. One resource per user; add one of these per default reviewer you want.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_project_default_reviewer" "lead" {
  project_key = bitbucket_project.platform.key
  user        = "jcardenas"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_key` (String) Key of the project to add the default reviewer to.
- `user` (String) UUID or Atlassian account ID of the user to add as a default reviewer.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/project_key/user".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_project_default_reviewer.lead PLAT/jcardenas
```
